author: Krassimir Kossev
releaseNotes:
2.1.9 2026-11-20 - commented out the Aqara FP300 fingerprint; use the dedicated FP300 driver instead.
2.1.8 2026-06-20 - code cleanup; re-enabled refresh() for FP300.
2.1.7 2026-06-14 - updated FP300 initialization.
2.1.6 2026-06-13 - Hubitat platform 2.5.0.157 Time Cluster compatibility; code cleanup.
2.1.5 2026-06-11 - added FP300 Time-cluster Read Attributes handling.
2.1.4 2026-06-06 - FP300 firmware 0.0.0_6542 release.
2.1.3 2026-06-03 - FP300 firmware 0.0.0_6542 compatibility fixes; improved preferences and presence reporting configuration.
2.1.2 2026-03-30 - commented out the Aqara FP300 fingerprint to prevent interference with the Dedicated Aqara FP300 Presence Multi-Sensor Zigbee Driver.
2.1.1 2025-12-30 - fixed rounding issue for temperature attribute
2.1.0 2025-11-23 - added FP300 advanced sampling configuration parameters (temp/humidity and light sampling frequency/period) with intelligent change detection; added sampling parameters to refresh() command;
1.7.5 2025-09-15 bbholthome  - light sensor GZCGQ01LM maximum illuminance capped to 65500 lux
1.7.4 2025-05-24 - HE platfrom version 2.4.1.x decimal preferences range patch/workaround.
1.7.3 2025-01-16 - first ping() throwing exception bug fix tnx@user2428 
1.7.2 2024-11-28 - HE platfrom 2.4.0.x compatibility fixes;
